segments.text: Tóm tắt ngắn: bạn có bằng chứng học thuật cho confidence intervals ở MAS291/CLO7 với score 9.43 và achievement excellent; CLO này yêu cầu xây dựng và diễn giải confidence intervals cho population parameters và differences between population parameters. Hypothesis testing cũng được xác nhận riêng ở MAS291/CLO8 với score 9.43, achievement excellent, vì CLO này yêu cầu verify claims about population parameters bằng hypothesis testing. Simple linear regression nằm ở MAS291/CLO9 với score 9.43, achievement excellent, trong đó CLO nêu xây dựng mô hình simple linear regression để prediction và interpretation. PCA nằm ở MAI391/CLO6 với score 9.4, achievement excellent, trong đó CLO nêu apply dimensionality reduction with PCA.

academic_sources.source_excerpt: Construct and interpret confidence intervals for population parameters and differences between population parameters, including intervals for means of normal distributions with known or unknown variance, large-sample intervals for population proportions, inference on differences between two means, and inference on differences between two proportions.

Verify claims about population parameters and differences between population parameters using hypothesis testing, including formulating hypotheses, identifying critical values and test statistics, computing p-values, recognizing testing errors, and conducting tests for single means, single proportions, differences between two means, and differences between two proportions.

Construct a simple linear regression model and use it for prediction and interpretation, including empirical models, least-squares estimation, sums of squares, regression equations, correlation coefficients, properties of least-squares estimators, and hypothesis tests for significance in simple linear regression.

Apply dimensionality reduction with PCA, including covariance matrices, maximum-variance subspaces, principal subspace bases, low-rank matrix approximation, PCA in high dimensions, projection perspectives, eigenvector computation, and key practical PCA steps.
